Get Stock Out Report.description: Fetches the dispensing unit's stock-out report, e.g. to feed a supply chain dashboard or DHIS2.

Check Prescription.description: Looks up one prescription by its row GUID to see whether it has been dispensed.

Get Prescription History Page.description: Fetches one page of prescription history, sent as form data.

Get Dispensing Request History.description: Lists past dispensing-unit requests (e.g. resupply requests to the store).
